purpose: Functional AppService live-worker validation of legacy Small/0.5 and fresh Standard/0.2 profiles after the separately reviewed application activation decision.

privacy.input: Existing public model-owner WAV only; no private meeting data
privacy.capture: Paced Python fake NDJSON helper; no input/output devices
privacy.storage: New temporary application root/database; verified caches and public WAV hardlinked without modification

source.origin: Official k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx June26 model archive test_wavs/0.wav
source.license_note: Model-owner Apache-2.0 distribution; no independent corpus accuracy acceptance claimed from this clean control

validation.build: debug test profile; native CPU models; Darwin arm64
validation.initial_assertion_correction: The first run passed Small and reached sealed Standard provenance, then failed a test-only f32 .2 vs f64 .2 exact comparison. The final test compares f64::from(expected f32); both final cases pass. No production code changed for this correction.

cases.selection: Legacy Small directory retained; no explicit preference inserted
Fresh Standard directory without legacy Small or explicit preference

asserted_for_both: Native STT/VAD and independent speaker workers ready before paced source feed
Sealed active live run complete; exactly one run; no automatic batch replacement
Stored requested model, exact f32 VAD threshold, VAD requested, enabled, CPU provider/two STT threads/runtime and archive/file pins match selected profile
Both tracks emit final words bounded by source and segment times; no partial IDs persisted
Remote Mic Me is labelled channel_prior; System has independent speaker turns and word assignments
No embedding vectors exposed in serialized detail
Every archived FLAC hash verified and decoded PCM24 exactly equals original public source, with all 106000 frames on each track
No non-ready audio chunks, inference gaps, shedding events or truncated backlog audit
Public source byte-identical after test and playback never started
limits: One clean 6.625-second public utterance duplicated across tracks, not a real multi-party conversation
No WER or DER scored in this integration test; retain the independent AMI train/holdout evidence
No GUI rendering, real-device capture/output, capture-to-visible latency or sustained thermal/long-call qualification
Backlog maximum is a bounded source-watermark audit observation, not a user-visible latency measurement
Does not satisfy the separate in-house four-speaker, gallery-of-50 or hardware acceptance gates
